defeats.how: Having beaten Ulik in combat with the reclaimed hammer, Thor knocked him out before he could throw the switch to kill Orikal.
defeats.evidence: Thor quickly knocks Ulik out before he can throw the switch

defeats.how: Thor freed Orikal, which made the Rock Trolls' weapons useless and turned the battle, so Geirrodur surrendered and agreed to return home.
defeats.evidence: Geirrodur agrees to surrender and complies with Thor's demand that the Rock Trolls return to their home
